summary_markdown: The team discussed the process for hashing MAC addresses. Initially, it was noted that all MAC addresses were hashed regardless of whether they were local or trusted. A decision was made to continue hashing all MAC addresses except for those identified as 'local' (локалы). Specifically, the practice of salting the hash should not be applied to local addresses. This change was confirmed based on a discussion held during a meeting with someone named Esben.
decisions: All MAC addresses must be hashed.
Local MAC addresses should be excluded from hashing/salting processes.
action_items: Remind the relevant team member (Tole) about the updated logic regarding local MAC addresses.
